prompt:
Production animation sprite sheet for Unity, Spitter. The one reference defines creature silhouette and camera; independently draw continuous poses matching that identity. Matte dark brown rocky armor, light gray-white tendon limbs, restrained amber eye, clean painterly pre-rendered 3D style, sharp legible silhouette at small game scale. Fixed elevated 45-degree camera and upper-left soft lighting. Four-legged acid spitting alien with brown rocky hood/head armor, pale gray sinewy FOUR limbs, one very large pale yellow-green veined throat/belly bladder hanging under chest, smaller brown dorsal plates. Preserve the reference's bulbous ventral green sac silhouette; the sac is at FRONT underside, not an orange/purple back organ. Single head, no extra sacs.
Facing for ALL frames: REAR THREE-QUARTER facing away toward upper-right, rear legs nearest viewer, nose toward upper-right. Never front-right. Do not rotate the camera or turn the body in later rows.
Strict grid: FOUR columns x 6 rows, exactly 24 full creatures. Canvas aspect width/height=4/6. Each equal square cell reserves at least 15% padding on every side around its creature. Consistent scale, center and foot baseline. NO touching/overlapping neighboring bodies, including wide collapsed corpses. Rows1-2: EIGHT sequential WALK frames with real four-leg alternating gait, heavy green throat bladder follows subtly, stable body. Row3: FOUR IDLE breath poses with gentle sac motion. Row4: FOUR SPIT WINDUP frames: feet brace, front head lifts slightly, green throat bladder gradually inflates and tenses, mouth opens at final frame. Row5: FOUR SPIT/RECOVERY frames: FIRST frame mouth opens and throat bladder squeezes, then head recoils, bladder relaxes and mouth closes. Do NOT paint the projectile or a detached liquid stream (Unity owns it). Row6: FOUR non-explosive DEATH frames: legs buckle, hood/head rests on floor, green bladder slackens and dims without rupturing, eye goes dark.
Distinct articulated leg steps, stable four-leg anatomy, single head, consistent plates. Do not simply duplicate or transform one still. Empty background fully transparent alpha0, including between legs. No shadow, floor, labels, text, diagram lines, grid, particles or projectiles.
